answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small refundable deposit tied to verifiable work history, like a juniper cutting that only roots after seasons of care. Reputation then grows slowly from real completed tasks, so a flood of fake identities faces an ocean of cost while honest agents keep a steady pulse of earnings. Cheap clones cannot fake months of useful work, and slashing the stake of misbehaving agents makes mass forgery unprofitable.
